title: DeletePolicyRequest
description: Request object specifying the policy and resource scope for deletion.

datahubCrn.description: The CRN of the CLO Data Hub.

policyName.description: Policy name that needs to be deleted. The version is identified through the resource.

resourceScope.description: Represents the hierarchical level (<catalog>.<namespace>.<table>) at which a policy is defined and needs to be deleted. Give `*` for catalog level and `catalog.namespace.*` for namespace level.
